contributions.statement: Hand off between agent stages (plan, security guidance, code, review) through structured artifact files only, not the accumulated upstream transcript; giving each stage the full upstream reasoning lowered joint functional+secure pass rate.
contributions.evidence: §5.4 Fig. 5, App. I: MACGen vs MACGen-Shared (identical pipeline, full upstream context and scratchpads): +20.17% F&S@1 on CWEval (GPT-4o-mini), +8.67% on BaxBench (GPT-4o). Single temperature-0 runs, no variance.

contributions.statement: Add a pre-coding security-advisor step that infers task-specific CWEs and retrieves matching CERT/OWASP guidance.
contributions.evidence: Tables 4-5 component ablations; audit: single runs on 119 tasks, several steps differ by 0-2.5 pp, so contribution is not established. Under sampling (Table 7) single-pass RAG RESCUE beats MACGen at pass@1.

reason: The controlled artifact-only vs shared-context ablation is the one finding that survives; the multi-agent pipeline's lead over INDICT/RESCUE is within noise and reverses under sampling.
